name: ScanBench
intro: ScanBench以303个临床病例模拟“问诊—辅助检查—诊断”完整流程，覆盖12个科室、8857个问诊检查项和38类检查动作，评估模型主动获取信息、选择必要检查及给出层级诊断的能力。

metric: SCAN四维评分, 加权F1, ICD-10层级匹配
eval_feature: 多轮问诊, 检查选择, 层级诊断
scale: 303个病例, 12个科室, 8857个问诊检查项, 38类检查动作
build_method_en: Three-station Clinical Case Transformation, Expert Annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-turn Inquiry, Test Selection, Hierarchical Diagnosis
intro_en: ScanBench turns 303 clinical cases into an Inquiry–Lab Testing–Diagnosis workflow across 12 departments, 8,857 inquiry checklist items, and 38 examination categories to assess active information gathering, necessary-test selection, and hierarchical diagnosis.
scale_en: 303 cases, 12 departments, 8,857 inquiry checklist items, 38 examination categories
metric_en: SCAN Dimensions, Weighted F1, Hierarchical ICD-10 Matching

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Baichuan-M3 arXiv:2602.06570 Sections 4.1.1-4.1.2 and Figure 4. ScanBench converts 303 clinical cases from 12 departments into the progressive workflow Inquiry, Lab Testing, and Diagnosis. Its inquiry ground truth contains 8,857 checklist items, averaging 29.23 per case, partitioned into Level 2 critical and Level 1 supplementary evidence. The lab station uses a unified action space of 38 examination categories and labels tests as essential or optional. During evaluation, a model first interviews a standardized patient; GPT-4.1 checks coverage of OSCE-derived clinical points and the SCAN framework scores Safety Stratification, Information Clarification, Associative Questioning, and Normative Output. The model then proposes a differential and selects tests, scored by weighted F1 with higher essential-test recall weight, before a final diagnosis is matched hierarchically against ICD-10.
